page.overview:
Who is Rael Averross?

Rael Averross, a Force-sensitive human male, was a Jedi and the Lord Regent of Pijal during the era of the Galactic Republic. Trained by Jedi Master Dooku, Averross took a less strict approach to the ways of the Jedi Order. Around 40 BBY, he requested the help of Qui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi during a dispute between Czerka Corporation and the Pijali monarchy.

Born on the planet Ringo Vinda during the era of the Galactic Republic, Rael Averross was inducted into the Jedi Order, having proven to be Force-sensitive, when he was five years old. He began training in the ways of the Force as the Padawan of Jedi Master Dooku by circa 80 BBY. After spending ten years as Dooku's Padawan, Averross was Knighted by circa 70 BBY. He, however, had difficulty conforming to the Jedi Code. With time, Averross had earned a reputation among members of the Order as a famous duelist.

Around 68 BBY, Averross joined him in instructing a clan of Jedi initiates. Averross convinced Dooku to join him in a lightsaber duel, in which his former master won. Afterward, Dooku accompanied him to the hangar, where Averross worked with Aitch-Sixteen on his starfighter's laser capacitors.

Later that year, Averross reunited with Dooku and met his former master's second apprentice, Qui-Gon Jinn (whom Dooku had been training for four months), in a battle on the planet of Shurrupak. Averross and Jinn formed a close connection, with Averross serving as a friend and mentor to Jinn. Their connection was close to the point that Jinn confided in Averross that Dooku had tortured Shenda Mol on Numidian Prime, though at the time Averross expressed that he was not all that concerned with his former master's conduct.
